The branch's presence at the centre is confirmed through Foto First's own official store locator and independently through the Mall of the North's own store directory, which places it at Shop L70 on the corner of the R81 and N1. It serves customers who need photographic printing or digital imaging done while they are already at the mall, from family photos and passport pictures to printing straight from a phone or memory card.

Great North Power Solutions distributes and maintains power generation and solar equipment from its base in Futura, Polokwane. Its diesel generators range from 5kVA to 1,100kVA, and it also stocks gas generators running on liquid petroleum gas or natural gas, plus single and three phase air-cooled Generac generators from 8 to 20kVA for domestic use.

The company also supplies solar panels, solar inverters, solar batteries, inverters and UPS units, solar geyser conversions, variable speed drives and control panels. It describes itself as an authorised Bundu Power dealer and says it works through a network of high quality suppliers, which allows it to offer competitive pricing for commercial, agricultural, industrial and domestic applications. The business serves customers who need generators or solar systems that are maintained after installation.

At Shop U13 in the Mall of the North, Bendor, Identity stocks contemporary clothing and accessories for shoppers who want current fashion without crossing town for it. The Mall of the North's own store directory places the branch within the centre's fashion line-up, trading daily alongside the mall's other clothing and accessories retailers.

The store focuses on casual and fashion-oriented apparel, giving shoppers a stop for everyday outfits as well as pieces for a night out. The Bendor branch is open from 09:00 to 19:00 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 17:00 on weekends and public holidays, a trading window that suits shoppers browsing after work as well as weekend visits to the mall.

JMR Trailer Parts supplies parts and accessories for trailers and trucks from its branch in Ladanna, trading under the JMR Group as JMR Transport Solutions (Pty) Ltd. The group's own branch directory lists the Polokwane operation alongside its other depots around the country, each offering parts and accessories together with roadside assistance for operators who break down on the road.

The Ladanna branch, confirmed through the group's own branch listing and a longstanding business posting for the Polokwane operation, trades from 108 Blaauwberg Street. It serves trailer, truck and transport operators who need replacement parts, fitment accessories or assistance when a vehicle is off the road, giving local operators a nearby source of parts rather than relying on a depot elsewhere in the province.

Jphen Beauty Spa is a massage and beauty clinic at 92A Hoog Street in Polokwane Central, where clients can book massage, nails, facials, waxing, lash extensions and makeup under one roof. Gel and acrylic nails start from R250, massage therapy from R230 and facials from R300, with lash extensions from R450 and makeup application from R600.

The spa is known for its signature ozone jacuzzi, a private outdoor soak that costs R400 an hour per person and suits birthdays and girls' days out. Its picnic-day packages combine a full body massage, a pedicure, a meat and fruit platter and a bottle of bubbly or wine for groups. The business describes itself as a small escape close to home, and it is open Tuesday to Sunday with bookings available on WhatsApp.

Keneilwe Mabapa Attorneys is a boutique law firm in Eduan Park, Polokwane, built around a small, focused practice rather than a large general firm. It handles family law matters, business and workplace law, estate planning and administration, mediation, and notarial and conveyancing work, covering the kind of legal needs individuals, families and smaller businesses run into over time.

Describing itself as a boutique practice, the firm aims to give clients closer attention on each file rather than passing matters down a large team. It is based on Holland Street in Eduan Park, Polokwane, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 16:00, suiting clients who need legal advice, estate planning or conveyancing handled by a practice that keeps its caseload manageable.

LimParts supplies mechanical and body parts for commercial Scania, Volvo, MAN and Shacman trucks and buses. The business was founded in 2017 by a team with more than 60 years of combined experience in the commercial truck and bus parts industry. Its range covers clutches, steering components, service parts, driveline items, suspension, electrical systems, headlights, braking systems and body parts.

The catalogue also includes lubrication products, engine fuel and exhaust systems, gearboxes, hubs and wheels, and used parts. Customers can request a quote for each brand from the website, and the business says it adds new brands as customer needs change. Regional contacts are listed for Limpopo, Gauteng, Mpumalanga and KwaZulu-Natal, and the business is listed in Futura, Polokwane.

Mary-Jane Mphahlele Attorneys Inc is a full-service law firm in Polokwane Central, describing itself on its own page as a top full-service, 100% black and women owned practice. Its work spans deceased estate administration, insolvency, dispute resolution, litigation and arbitration, divorce and family law, commercial law, debt collection, insurance law, personal injury and medical negligence claims, trusts and media law.

That spread of practice areas lets the firm act for individuals needing a divorce or an estate wound up as well as businesses facing a commercial dispute or needing debt collected. It trades from the Thabakgolo Building on Landdros Mare Street in Polokwane Central, a central location for clients across Polokwane who need a single firm able to handle matters across these different areas of law.

Mohlakaneng High School is a public, no-fee, co-educational high school in Seshego Zone 1, teaching Grades 8 to 12 under the National Senior Certificate and CAPS curriculum. As a no-fee school, government funding covers its running costs, removing school fees as a barrier for families in the area.

Current school data records 811 learners and 23 educators at the school, with an 87.8% pass rate in recent results. It serves secondary school learners from Seshego and the surrounding areas of Polokwane, offering a full run of subjects through to matric for a local community that would otherwise need to travel further for public secondary schooling.

Ngwenya Accounting and Tax Services provides accounting, tax, payroll and business compliance services to individuals and businesses in Polokwane and Pretoria. It has more than 10 years of experience, and its services include bookkeeping, financial statements, taxation, advisory work and business registration.

Tax work covers income tax returns, VAT submissions and tax planning. The payroll service covers salary calculations, payslips, SARS EMP201 and EMP501 returns and UIF declarations. Business compliance includes company registration, CIPC annual returns, COIDA submissions and VAT registration.

The firm offers free consultations and is based in Polokwane Central, suiting individuals and businesses that want their books and returns kept up to date.

Polokwane Estate Lodge and Spa is a lodge and spa in Dalmada, Polokwane, offering two standard rooms for a quick overnight stop, seven deluxe rooms and one executive suite. Rooms sleep two to three guests, and the lodge is priced from R490 for two people sharing.

Guests have free wifi, safe parking, a swimming pool and a luxury spa, and breakfast, lunch and dinner are available for an extra charge. The lodge is close to Bakone Malapa, and it offers transfers, with an Uber trip from Polokwane at R150 and a taxi at R25 for a single trip. Check-in is from 13:00 and check-out is at 10:00.

The site serves motorists filling up on this side of the city as well as shoppers stopping in at the convenience store for everyday items while they refuel.

As a Sasol-branded site with its own convenience retail offering, the station gives local residents and passing motorists a fuel stop paired with a small retail outlet in one visit, rather than a bare forecourt. It is a straightforward, everyday stop for Bendor motorists needing fuel or a quick in-and-out purchase on their way through the suburb.

Its range includes bolt and nut shelving, gondola shelving and wallbands, with light, medium and heavy duty racking, cantilever and mole racking.

The company also makes checkouts, barriers, baskets, trolleys, turnstiles and customised display units, in wood, glass, aluminium, metal and wire. Its services cover design advice, manufacturing and installation. The business says it supplies hardware stores, supermarkets, pharmacies, clothing retailers and warehouses, and that one customer has relied on it as a shelving, racking and shopfitting supplier for over 20 years. It is based in Superbia, Polokwane.

Skin Deep Polokwane is a beauty and aesthetics salon in the Thornhill Shopping Centre, established in 2013 to offer a quality salon that is affordable for women in Polokwane. Its treatments cover hair removal, skin treatments and beauty treatments, carried out by trained therapists and aestheticians.

The salon says its philosophy puts the client first, with a team committed to high standards for procedures, product knowledge and aftercare. The owner has more than 20 years of experience in the beauty field and keeps the team up to date with world-renowned brands. Appointments can be made by phone or email, and the salon is a good fit for clients who want regular treatments close to home.

Sugar Cube Cafe is a cafe and restaurant on Burger Street in Polokwane Central, serving breakfast, lunch and drinks through the day. Its lunch menu, served daily from 12:00 to 17:00, includes burgers, steak, lamb curry and lamb chops alongside lighter options, giving dine-in and takeaway customers a proper sit-down meal rather than just a quick coffee stop.

The cafe is known for its garden setting, with outdoor seating that extends its cosy interior into a relaxed, leafy space, and it serves breakfast alongside its lunch offering for customers who prefer an earlier start. Based in Polokwane Central, it suits breakfast, lunch and dine-in customers looking for a relaxed setting to eat rather than a fast-food stop.

Tirhani Lodge is a guest house in Hospital Park, Polokwane, holding a 4-star tourism grading as an accommodation establishment in the city. It offers overnight guests a graded alternative to a hotel, trading from Van Nispen Street in a quiet part of the suburb close to the city centre.

The lodge is listed among Polokwane's graded accommodation options and takes bookings for travellers passing through or staying in the city for business or leisure. It suits guests who want a short-stay base with a recognised quality grading behind it rather than booking somewhere unrated, and its Hospital Park address keeps it within easy reach of the Polokwane CBD.

ZUCH Accommodation offers self-catering guest apartments and suites in Penina Park, Polokwane. The units are aimed at business travellers, families, contractors and guests who need a base for a few weeks, and the business describes them as practical, private accommodation.

One unit is a spacious two-bedroom apartment with a private lounge, a full kitchen and a small garden patio, which suits families and groups and sleeps five. Another two-bedroom apartment has a full kitchen and in-room televisions, suited to contractors and colleagues sharing a stay, and sleeps four. A third option is an air-conditioned suite with a queen and a single bed, a private bathroom and a television, suited to couples and small families. Bookings can be made on the website or through WhatsApp.

APD Limpopo's Centenary House provides residential and support services for people with disabilities in Penina Park, Polokwane, including day care and a protective workshop programme alongside its residential accommodation. The National Council for Persons with Disabilities describes the kind of independent-living environment the organisation runs, with residential houses and support tailored to each resident's level of need and accessibility.

The centre is also recorded as offering guesthouse and catering facilities together with accessible transport, extending its role beyond long-term residential care into support that families and visitors can draw on too. It serves people with disabilities and their families and caregivers across Limpopo, giving the province a residential option built specifically around accessibility and day-to-day support.

Brace Yourself Orthodontics offers removable and fixed orthodontics, retainers, mouth guards and maintenance advice, including oral hygiene, home care and what to eat with braces. The practice aims to help patients feel more confident with their smile.

A first appointment starts with a friendly welcome and a record of the patient's dental history, followed by a thorough examination and impressions to make a model for treatment planning. Two radiographs are taken to assess jaw growth and dentition, with photos of the face and teeth. The team then discusses possible treatment plans and gives a detailed plan with a cost estimate. The practice is in Bendor, Polokwane.

Bronkhorst Crane Hire has been operating for more than 30 years, providing crane and truck hire, steel erection and rigging solutions. Its personnel are based at the head office in Polokwane, and the company describes its approach as built around understanding each client's specific needs.

The business says it takes on challenging projects of unique character, from large and complex jobs to smaller ones, with managers involved from start to finish on every project. It says it supplies high-quality mobile cranes and keeps them maintained. Clients are served by a team that treats them as partners, and the company is based in Futura, Polokwane.

Ethen Guesthouse is a guest house in Fauna Park, Polokwane, about 7.8 km from the airport, 2.3 km from the city centre, 5.4 km from the Mall of the North and 500 m from Savannah Mall. Its classic rooms have colourful accents, en-suite bathrooms, satellite television, free wifi, tea and coffee making equipment and a mini bar fridge.

Room prices start at R700 for a double or single room, R800 for a twin room, R950 for a deluxe room for two adults and a child, and R1,350 for a family room for two adults and two children. The guest house describes itself as convenient, reasonably priced and situated in a quiet and safe area. Guests have access to the pool, dining rooms and a braai area, and they can bring their own food. All rooms are non-smoking, with a smoking area beside the pool.

Macgyver Commercial specialises in panel beating and spray painting for passenger and commercial vehicles. It handles advanced and major body repairs on accident-damaged vehicles and trucks, from small fender-benders to major damage.

The business says it works with all major insurance companies and is approved by a number of vehicle and truck manufacturers. The website has separate lists of approved truck and approved vehicle manufacturers, along with a gallery of its work. Passenger vehicle work is handled from the office in Blaauwberg Street, Polokwane Extension 16, and heavy commercial vehicles are handled at the workshop in Rivier Street in the same area. Customers can get in touch by phone for a quote.

McDonald's Seshego Circle is a branch of the McDonald's quick-service chain trading from the Seshego Circle Shopping Centre in Seshego, Polokwane. The restaurant serves the chain's usual menu of burgers, chicken, fries, beverages and other McDonald's items, available for dine-in, takeaway and drive-through at the Seshego Circle site.

Trading as part of the shopping centre, the restaurant gives Seshego shoppers and passing motorists a familiar fast-food option alongside the centre's other retailers, without needing to travel into central Polokwane for it. It suits general fast-food customers, families doing a shopping trip, and takeaway or drive-through customers wanting a quick meal on the way through Seshego.

Midas Seshego Plaza is a branch of the Midas automotive parts and accessories chain, trading from Shop 29 in Seshego Plaza on New Era Drive, Seshego. The store supplies parts, accessories and related motor products drawn from Midas' national range, backed by the group's own distribution network and a catalogue of well over 100,000 part numbers across vehicle makes and models.

The branch serves vehicle owners, motorists, workshops and trade customers in and around Seshego who need parts or accessories without travelling into central Polokwane for them. It is open Monday to Friday from 07:30 to 17:30, Saturdays from 07:30 to 13:30 and Sundays from 08:00 to 13:00, giving both DIY motorists and trade customers a wide window to get parts over a weekend repair job.

Mugg & Bean is a Famous Brands coffee-shop and restaurant chain known for all-day breakfasts, generous lunches and its oversized muffins, and its Mall of the North branch brings that same menu to Bendor. The Shop U44 restaurant serves breakfast, brunch, lunch, coffee and baked goods and desserts for customers settling in at a table or grabbing something on the way through the centre.

Confirmed through the restaurant's own official branch page, the Mall of the North Mugg & Bean offers both dine-in and takeaway service, open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 19:00 and on weekends from 08:00 to 17:00. It suits restaurant customers, families and friends meeting up over coffee, as well as anyone wanting a sit-down meal or a quick takeaway while shopping at the mall.

At Mugg & Bean's branch in The Greenery on Oost Street, the restaurant describes itself as a place where customers become regulars and regulars become friends, serving freshly brewed coffee, bottomless drinks and generous breakfast, brunch and lunch plates alongside muffins and cakes made from scratch. The Shop 05 restaurant lists family-friendly facilities among its amenities, catering for parents and children as well as groups of friends and colleagues.

The branch takes dine-in, takeaway and online orders, open Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 19:00, Saturdays from 08:00 to 19:00 and Sundays from 08:00 to 17:00. It gives Polokwane Central diners a coffee-shop and restaurant option within The Greenery for everything from a working breakfast to a family lunch out.
